scientific_integrity: A self-contained unconditional proof is supplied; finite verification is supplementary. The general greedy Apery-set theorem of Liu et al. provides substantial prior algorithmic coverage, distinguished from the explicit closed-form optimization proved here.
scientific_limitations: Only odd coefficients of binary Hamming weight seven. No formula for genus, type, or other Hamming weights. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Binary-weight-seven Proth semigroups have an exact Frobenius number
